guardrails.enforcement: No writes to live scoring, candidate generation, translator code, budget logic, or legacy infrastructure.
guardrails.failure_response: Stop and redesign as read-only artifact.
guardrails.rule: Stage 6A is a shadow specification only.

guardrails.enforcement: Do not blend support, decay, low-denominator, and restraint rows into one pool.

guardrails.rule: Primary spec seed is restrained candidate-expression behavior.

guardrails.enforcement: Source A/source B aliases are locators, not independent votes.
guardrails.rule: Secondary lane must carry lineage de-duplication.

guardrails.enforcement: Treat overlap as narrowing/restraint unless it beats the best individual source on support rate.
guardrails.failure_response: Keep overlap as pool narrowing or restraint.

guardrails.enforcement: Keep support context as paired context, not standalone candidate expression.

guardrails.enforcement: Carry decay columns as companion annotations only.

guardrails.enforcement: Calibrate restraint as penalty/veto pressure, not an automatic discard rule.
guardrails.rule: Calibrate restraint as penalty/veto pressure before any hard exclusion.

guardrails.enforcement: Carry concentration warning in all Stage 6B outputs.
guardrails.failure_response: Do not promote from shadow spec to live rewrite.
guardrails.rule: Positive-conversion metrics are March-led until future/fresh windows repeat the shape.

guardrails.enforcement: Do not append a confirmed macro finding until Stage 5 readback conclusions repeat on a future/fresh window or are explicitly reviewed as provisional.
guardrails.failure_response: Keep finding in readback/spec memo only.
guardrails.rule: Macro Findings Log receives evidence-led findings, not infrastructure milestones.
